craft_notes: Sthāyin: the signed colophon — āmnāya + vivicana + kṛta + name (the verse performs authorship). Sanskrit-first: bhaṭṭendurājāt āmnāya kept the lineage-source; ciraṃ dhiyā kept long-with-thought; kṛto 'bhinavaguptena kept passive signature; so 'yaṃ kept this-here (deictic seal). Rows: 9 (tradition/thought/maker chain), 1 ('the Gītārthasaṃgraha' closes — the NAME lands last, the verse's whole purpose). Close: 'the Gītārthasaṃgraha.' Rejected: 'Abhinavagupta composed this' reorder — killed: passive signature is the printed shape (maker-last, name-last); 'understood' for vivicya — kept examined.

lines: examined long with thought, made by Abhinavagupta:
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhaṭṭendurājādāmnāya vivicya ca ciraṃ dhiyā kṛto'bhinavaguptena so'yaṃ gītārthasaṃgrahaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is this work's colophon? → The verse seals authorship: āmnāya from Bhaṭṭa Indurāja (his Pratyabhijñā teacher), long vivicana, kṛta by Abhinavagupta — the name declared.
c1_essence: Bhaṭṭa Indurāja's tradition, long-examined, made by Abhinavagupta: the name declared.
